entities.name: Map Room
entities.description: A cavernous chamber in the Evincar of Rath's quarters inside the Stronghold, displaying a living map of Dominaria.

entities.name: Stronghold
entities.description: Structure on Rath later shifted to Urborg on Dominaria.

entities.name: Evincar of Rath
entities.description: Ruler whose quarters hold the Map Room.

entities.name: Rath
entities.description: The plane assaulted by the Weatherlight Crew.

entities.name: Dominaria
entities.description: The plane Rath was to merge with.

entities.name: Urborg
entities.description: Place on Dominaria where the Stronghold was shifted.

entities.name: Weatherlight Crew
entities.description: Crew that entered the Map Room while searching for Sisay and Takara.

entities.name: Volrath
entities.description: Ruler who discovered the intruders; his masters planned to invade Dominaria.

entities.name: Gerrard
entities.description: Weatherlight crew member who urged them deeper into the Stronghold.

entities.name: Crovax
entities.description: Crew member who suffered a megrim attack near Selenia.

entities.name: Selenia
entities.description: Presence whose proximity caused Crovax's attack.

entities.name: Eladamri
entities.description: Infiltrator who helped destroy the Map Room.

entities.name: Sivvi en-Vec
entities.description: Infiltrator who helped destroy the Map Room.

entities.name: Grizzlegom
entities.description: Infiltrator who helped destroy the Map Room.

entities.name: Rathi Overlay
entities.description: Event during which the Stronghold shifted to Dominaria.

events.summary: Part of the Weatherlight Crew enters the Map Room and learns that Volrath's masters plan to invade Dominaria; an alarm sounds.
events.quote: They realized the ambition of Volrath 's masters was to invade Dominaria

events.summary: During the Rathi Overlay the Map Room is shifted with the Stronghold to Urborg.
events.quote: the Map Room was shifted with the rest of the Stronghold to Urborg on Dominaria

events.summary: Eladamri, Sivvi en-Vec and Grizzlegom, angered by the invasion map, destroy the entire room.
events.quote: they proceeded to destroy the entire room and all its mechanisms

relations.quote: they proceeded to destroy the entire room and all its mechanisms
